post.description: First sign-in: a new authenticator app (QR code and the same secret as text).

Lost phone: password plus one recovery code. The code is used up, the old authenticator is
removed and the new session must enrol a new one (which issues a new set of codes).
🔒 Ten new recovery codes for the signed-in person only; the old set stops working.

A code from the authenticator app: completes sign-in, or steps up for 10 minutes.

The session gets new cookies. Finishing enrolment issues the ten recovery codes, shown once.
The same answer whether or not the address has an account.
The link from the reset email plus a new password. Signs out every device.

get.description: Where this session stands; reading it does not count as activity.

post.description: Password step. Sets the session cookies; the session stays at `mfa_required` until a code is verified.

get.description: Audio, video and imaging files: kept and listed, never paged or read (F36).

post.description: An assistant's call suggests; the named expert's confirms (accepting any suggestion).

A clearer copy (uploaded as later records) replaces the page. Its first page supersedes the
old one once it has been cut into pages; the old page keeps its number, stays readable and keeps
its facts.

get.description:
The latest processing job, so screen 07 can follow it after an upload (architecture 5.3). An upload
is scanned first and the scan queues the bundle job, so the screen follows the newest until it ends.

post.description: Processes whatever is not done yet: finished pages are never read again.
Stops processing at the next page boundary; pages being read finish and are kept.
The opt-in to read every page again with the cell's current model; verified facts never change.
